summary: Iteration 4 testing of Flareonix Prompt 2: backend regression (26/26 pytest pass), plus full frontend audit of new surfaces: /blog (public + logged-in), /blog/:slug detail with comment posting, Home WhatWereBuilding section, /about anchor sections (#projects, #gallery, #collaborations), /consultation + /growth-consultation + /agency (all 3 alias routes render the SAME Growth Consultation page), Navbar/Footer link changes. Found and fixed 1 CRITICAL frontend bug: HomePage.jsx referenced <WhatWereBuilding /> without importing it -> ReferenceError caused the entire homepage to render blank (white screen of death). After 1-line import fix, home page renders all 4 sub-sections correctly. All other features verified working.

ui_bugs.issue: (FIXED) <WhatWereBuilding /> used but not imported - caused full home page crash with 'WhatWereBuilding is not defined' ReferenceError. Added 'import WhatWereBuilding from @/components/home/WhatWereBuilding'.

The 'Post Comment' submit button has an ember/fire animated decoration rendered ON TOP of the button text — the orange button label is partially obscured by floating fire-particle glow. Not blocking (button still clicks fine) but reduces readability.

When the slug in the URL does not exist (e.g. /blog/flareonix-rise when only test-flareonix-rise-f877b8 exists), the page silently renders the BLOG LIST page header & footer with no 'Not Found' message — confusing UX. Consider showing a 404-style 'Post not found' card with a link back to /blog. NOTE: This is NOT a crash; the route resolves; the data fetch returns 404 and BlogPostPage renders an empty fallback. The test script's expectation of slug 'flareonix-rise' was incorrect — no such post exists in the DB; admin must create one with that exact slug if it is intended to be a permanent landing.

action_items: (ALREADY FIXED by testing agent) Added missing 'import WhatWereBuilding from @/components/home/WhatWereBuilding' in /app/frontend/src/pages/HomePage.jsx — please confirm style is OK and that the file does not get auto-regenerated by visual-edits Babel plugin.

(LOW) BlogPostPage should render a clean 'Post not found' fallback when the slug doesn't match any post instead of just showing the navbar+footer. Currently the body looks suspiciously like the list page because BlogPage layout shines through.
(LOW) Move the ember-particle / glow decoration BEHIND the blog-comment-submit button text (z-index issue) so the label is fully readable.
(OPTIONAL) Consider seeding a permanent 'flareonix-rise' published blog post if this slug is intended to be a stable landing URL (referenced in the testing prompt).
critical_code_review_comments: HomePage.jsx had a critical missing import that fully bricked the home page — please ensure CI/lint catches undefined JSX identifiers (eslint react/jsx-no-undef rule). This was a silent failure with NO compile-time error because of how the Babel visual-edits plugin handles JSX.

Animation engine appears to work but the [data-animate] elements only number 2 on the home page despite the spec calling for fade/scale transitions on each new card — the engine attaches the trigger class on enter, but it didn't fire in the current viewport. Consider verifying the IntersectionObserver root margin and confirming engine is started AFTER the dynamic content is mounted.
Growth Consultation pricing is rendered as a SINGLE <table>, exactly 1 table on page — matches the 'single scrollable pricing comparison table (no tabs)' requirement.
Other Services grid renders exactly 15 items as required.
All 3 alias routes (/consultation, /growth-consultation, /agency) successfully render the same GrowthConsultationPage — wiring in App.js is correct.
Navbar shows Blog + Growth Consultation links; Agency link is correctly removed.
/about anchor sections #projects, #gallery, #collaborations all exist as DOM ids — anchor navigation works.

Blog logged-in flow works end-to-end: search enabled, sort dropdown visible, post body fetched, comment posted via POST /api/blog/posts/{id}/comments returns 200, new comment appears in thread, success toast 'Comment posted' shown.

Blog public (logged-out) flow works: heading 'Flareonix Updates & Insights' present, search input disabled with 'Login to search' placeholder, 'Login to read' overlay on post cards. blog-login-cta and the 'Join the community' card only render when posts >= 3 — currently only 1 post exists, so they were not visible (correct behavior, not a bug).

Backend pytest suite (26 tests) still passes 100% — no regression in /api/blog/posts, /api/team, /api/projects, /api/collaborations, /api/testimonials, /api/case-studies, /api/settings, admin metrics, or AI tools list.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_content_admin.py is the regression suite — keep running it. Frontend critical bug (missing WhatWereBuilding import) has been fixed by testing agent. Blog detail page slug used by test prompt ('flareonix-rise') doesn't exist as a real post; the test post created in iteration 3 was at slug 'test-flareonix-rise-f877b8'. rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE (home page blank): /app/frontend/src/pages/HomePage.jsx referenced <WhatWereBuilding /> inside JSX without importing the component. React threw 'ReferenceError: WhatWereBuilding is not defined' at render time, which the missing top-level ErrorBoundary did not catch, resulting in the entire HomePage tree unmounting and a fully blank screen. REPRODUCTION: simply navigate to / → completely black body except 'Made with Love' badge → console shows 'PAGEERROR WhatWereBuilding is not defined' + React error-boundary warning. MITIGATION: Added 'import WhatWereBuilding from @/components/home/WhatWereBuilding' to HomePage.jsx (1-line addition between EmberBadge import and AuthContext import). After hot reload, home page renders with navbar, hero, stats, achieve cards, AND the new 'What We're Building' section with all 4 sub-sections (Projects in motion, The team behind the fire, From the journal, Our Ecosystem). PREVENTION: enable ESLint react/jsx-no-undef rule in /app/frontend/.eslintrc to catch this at lint-time.
